requirements.label: Survey Sequence: 2 Courses in 1 Sequence
requirements.hint: Two courses from the same pre-approved sequence on the History Department's Survey Sequence List (Rev. November 2021), linked from the department's Major Requirements page; the list itself gives examples: HISTORY 260 and 261 (United States), HISTORY 204 and 205 (East Asia), HISTORY 210 and 211 (European Middle Ages). This checker counts any two courses from the list, so confirm both of yours come from one sequence. HISTORY 445 counts only with the Capitalism topic and HISTORY 407 only with the Problem of Genocide topic. Alternate pairings need approval from a History advisor.

requirements.label: Regional Distribution: 4 of 7 Areas
requirements.hint: Minimum 4 areas with minimum 1 course per area, from North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East/Central Asia, Africa, Asia, and Transregional/Global. Can be fulfilled by survey sequence or major courses.

requirements.label: North American History
requirements.hint: 1 course designated United States or United States & Canada on the History Department's Fall 2026 and Winter 2026 course lists. Topics and colloquium numbers (HISTORY 230, 231, 328, 329, 399, 491, 496, 497) get a region per section and are not auto-counted here; check the term list for your section. HISTORY 202 and mini-courses cannot satisfy regional distribution.

Individual sections of HISTORY 328, 399, and 496 sometimes carry a Pre-1800 designation for a specific topic; those are not auto-counted here, so check the term list for your section.

requirements.label: HISTORY 491, 496, or 497
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: HISTORY 491 (Topics in History: HistoryLabs II), HISTORY 496, or HISTORY 497 (History Colloquium).

requirements.label: 5 Courses in History at 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: Courses may also count toward the requirements above.

requirements.label: Major Total: Minimum 10 Courses
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements; approved courses from other departments also count (audited here as History courses).

requirements.label: Major Residency: 5 History Courses at U-M Ann Arbor
